These projects show how I frame analytical questions, build reproducible workflows, evaluate evidence, and translate technical results into practical conclusions. Each repository includes methods, retained results, and documentation for closer review.

## Advanced Analytics, Experimentation, and Decision Science

:::: {.project-grid}
::: {.project-card}
<p class="project-type">Business intelligence · Sampling · Segmentation</p>

### Freight Cost & Sampling Analysis

Analyzed a 500,000-trip synthetic U.S. freight network using sampling simulation, route-level business intelligence, cost-driver analysis, confounding controls, and operational segmentation.

The study shows why like-for-like comparisons matter: the raw load-cost relationship was nearly absent across the network but became strong after route, month, and hour were held constant.

[View repository →](https://github.com/JacobWillson13/freight-cost-analysis)
:::

::: {.project-card}
<p class="project-type">Experimental design · LLM evaluation · Deployment</p>

### Gemma 4 Security-Advisory Evaluation

Designed and analyzed a 3,900-run local experiment measuring how model size, supplied evidence, reasoning configuration, and temperature affect accuracy, latency, reliability, and deployment trade-offs.

The retained results support reproducible analysis without rerunning inference and frame model selection as an operating decision rather than a leaderboard exercise.

[View repository →](https://github.com/JacobWillson13/gemma4-eval)
:::

::: {.project-card}
<p class="project-type">Synthetic data · Time series · Predictive evaluation</p>

### Synthetic UAV Telemetry Evaluation

Compared seven synthetic time-series generation approaches across two UAV datasets using statistical fidelity and train-synthetic/test-real evaluation.

The study found that useful predictive signal can survive generation, but performance depends on generation strategy, data volume, and preservation of multivariate structure.

[View repository →](https://github.com/JacobWillson13/uav-pnt)
:::

<p class="project-type">NLP · Ontology validation · Research methods</p>

### SCIO Ontology Validation

Combined deductive literature validation, inductive recovery, LLM-assisted evidence coding, embeddings, clustering, network analysis, topology, and structured human review.

The work evaluates both the usefulness of individual analytical features and whether the proposed theoretical branches are recovered by empirical structure.

[View repository →](https://github.com/JacobWillson13/scio-eval)
:::

::: {.project-card}
<p class="project-type">RAG · Information retrieval · Evaluation</p>

### DOME Handbook RAG

Built a local handbook question-answering application and two evaluation studies containing 6,672 question-level results across retrieval strategies, embedding choices, and language models.

The project connects an interactive Gradio prototype with retained evaluation data, deterministic summaries, and documented study boundaries.

[View repository →](https://github.com/JacobWillson13/dome-rag)
:::

::: {.project-card}
<p class="project-type">Document intelligence · Benchmarking · Reproducibility</p>

### CiteBench

Developed a reproducible benchmark comparing citation-extraction workflows across PDF, text, vision, targeted-context, hybrid, and specialist-parser approaches.

The repository preserves a 705-row result snapshot, representative evidence chains, shared schemas, scoring tools, and validation checks.

[View repository →](https://github.com/JacobWillson13/citebench)
